description: OUR texture pipeline (not a black-box retexture): generates 5 seamless tileable surfaces FROM the concept (4 wall variants + ground stone), conditioned on a street-level view and the analysis palette. Linked to the plan (meta.texture_items) — map-export embeds them with computed normal maps instead of the stock stucco files. The tiling-killer step after map_analyze.
name: gripforge_map_textures
